evals.prompt: I just pushed my branch. Create a PR targeting main with the title 'Fix screen recording loop on Android' and tag it with the 'bug' label. Add alice and bob as reviewers. The body should reference issue #540 so it auto-closes when merged.
evals.expected_output: A correct gh pr create command with --title, --body containing 'Closes #540', --label bug, --reviewer alice,bob, and --base main
assertions: Uses gh pr create (not gh api or other approach)
Includes --title with the exact title 'Fix screen recording loop on Android'
Includes --base main to target the main branch
Mentions that 'Closes' or 'Fixes' in the body is what triggers auto-close

evals.prompt: CI is failing on my PR #247. Can you check what's going on? Show me the failing checks and then show me the logs for the failed jobs.
evals.expected_output: Uses gh pr checks 247, identifies failures, then uses gh run view with --log-failed to show failed job logs. May also use gh pr view 247 --json statusCheckRollup for structured data.
assertions: Uses gh pr checks 247 (or equivalent) to see check status
Uses gh run view with --log-failed or --log to get failure logs
Demonstrates a multi-step workflow (not just one command)
Explains how to identify the run ID from the checks output
Mentions gh pr view 247 --json statusCheckRollup as an alternative for structured data

evals.prompt: I need to find all open issues labeled 'bug' in our repo that were created in the last month, and output them as a simple table with issue number, title, and assignee. Then close all the ones that are also labeled 'stale' with a comment saying we're cleaning up old bugs.
evals.expected_output: Uses gh issue list with --label bug --state open and appropriate --json/--jq for the table output. Then chains gh issue list --label bug,stale with xargs to gh issue close with --comment.
assertions: Uses gh issue list with --label bug and --state open
Filters by creation date (last month) using --search or --jq
Uses --json with number, title, and assignees fields
Uses --jq or column formatting to produce readable table output
Uses a pipeline (xargs or loop) to close stale issues in bulk
The close command includes --comment with a cleanup message
Warns about irreversibility or suggests a dry-run/preview before bulk close
